about: A map of amounts by a number (docs/adr/0108, D2 to D4): a put of a key that is absent goes last and one of a key that is present replaces its value where it stands; `has` asks whether a key is held, and a read of a key that is absent fails, raising error.execution and ending its block; a remove with an outcome says whether it removed, one without says nothing, and `<sce:clear>` empties the map. A map is stated as the array of its entries, each [key, value], in the order its keys were first put. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: nor an amount at 7: the read fails, error.execution is raised and the block ends before `after` counts it
7 is held already: its amount is replaced where it stands, and the map holds as many as it did
7 is gone: removing it again removes nothing and says so
a remove that names no outcome removes nothing of a key that is absent, and raises nothing
